answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization methods aim to produce new summaries, which can be obtained through selection, compression and reformulation of the given source document.

answer_2.quote: We employ the same set of automated metrics used in ENTSUM, namely ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L and BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: Three independent raters evaluated all 480 summaries each.
answer_4.guideline: Summaries are ranked on a Likert scale of 1 to 5, with a focus on crucial aspects: entity-specificity (or relevance), factuality (or consistency), and fluency aligning with previous work on human evaluation for summarization. We also include completeness, specifically for measuring the controllability aspect and an overall quality score.
